description: Defines data structures and API functions for managing a vector of group add entries, used during add requests in a data model. Contains structure definitions for group add entries and vectors, as well as function prototypes for initialization, destruction, adding objects and parameters, handling failures, rollback, and fixup operations.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources associated with a group_add_vector_t.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_AddObjectToCreate
methods.description: Adds a new object to the vector for creation, specifying request path, response path, and group ID.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_AddParamSetting
methods.description: Adds a parameter setting to the vector, specifying parameter name, value, and whether it is required.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_AddObjectNotCreated
methods.description: Marks an object as not created, with an error code and message.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_CreateObject
methods.description: Creates an object based on a group_add_entry_t and a combined role.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_FindFirstFailedParam
methods.description: Finds the first failed parameter in a group_add_entry_t.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_Rollback
methods.description: Performs rollback on the group add vector over a specified span.

methods.name: GROUP_ADD_VECTOR_FixupSECacheInstanceNumbers
methods.description: Fixes instance numbers in the SE cache for the group add vector.
